name: MCP JIRA Server
description: Enables comprehensive interaction with JIRA through the Model Context Protocol, supporting issue management, search, comments, attachments, workflow transitions, and custom fields with enterprise Kerberos authentication.

rawRecord.description: Enables comprehensive interaction with JIRA through the Model Context Protocol, supporting issue management, search, comments, attachments, workflow transitions, and custom fields with enterprise Kerberos authentication.

JIRA_URL.description: The URL of your JIRA instance (e.g., https://jira.yourcompany.com)

LOG_LEVEL.description: Logging level (e.g., INFO, DEBUG, WARNING, ERROR)

JIRA_EMAIL.description: Your JIRA email address. Required when AUTH_METHOD=api_token

JIRA_API_TOKEN.description: Your JIRA API token. Required when AUTH_METHOD=api_token

KERBEROS_PRINCIPAL.description: Kerberos principal for authentication (e.g., HTTP/jira.yourcompany.com@REALM). Required when AUTH_METHOD=kerberos

KERBEROS_KEYTAB_PATH.description: Path to Kerberos keytab file. Required when AUTH_METHOD=kerberos

CUSTOM_FIELDS_CACHE_TTL.description: Time-to-live for custom fields cache in seconds

rawRecord.name: MCP JIRA Server
